title: Pithyx images lock v1
description: backend/images.lock.json of an app package (D315): for every image reference of the Compose file, the platform manifest and the config digest (the image id) per architecture. `pithyx lock` writes it from the registry; the box checks every image it loads or pulls against it.

images.description: One entry per image reference, exactly as the Compose file writes it.

additionalProperties.description: The image per architecture of Pithyx: amd64 (x86-64) and arm64.

manifest.description: The digest of the image manifest for this architecture (the reference's own digest for a single-platform image).

config.description: The digest of the image config, which Docker shows as the image id.
